kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أغتنم (form VIII)
# أَغْتَنِمُ (ʔaḡtanimu) /ʔaɣ.ta.ni.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
# أُغْتَنَمُ (ʔuḡtanamu) /ʔuɣ.ta.na.mu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
# أَغْتَنِمَ (ʔaḡtanima) /ʔaɣ.ta.ni.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
# أُغْتَنَمَ (ʔuḡtanama) /ʔuɣ.ta.na
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
